newsitem.title: UK: Five lead managers top $25 billion bonds by end-Q3.
newsitem.headline: Five lead managers top $25 billion bonds by end-Q3.

text.p: Five investment banks had each lead-managed transactions totalling at least $25 billion by the end of the third quarter, Capital DATA Bondware said.
Merrill Lynch kept its number one position by underwriting 206 issues worth a total of $38.7 billion, versus 190 deals worth $30.5 billion in all of 1995.
SBC Warburg was second with $29.2 billion (161 bonds).
Goldman Sachs moved up to third spot in the league table with $28.0 billion just pipping Morgan Stanley's $27.9 billion.
JP Morgan ($25.5 billion) was fifth. CS First Boston, Lehman Brothers, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, UBS and ABN AMRO Hoare Govett completed the top 10.
